versions.changelog:
Initial release of tianapi-weibo-hot skill.

- Provides real-time Weibo hot search list with trending topics, heat score, and topic links.
- Requires TIANAPI_WEIBO_HOT_KEY (API key from TianAPI) for operation.
- Includes script for command line retrieval and instructions for both script-based and API-based access.
- Detailed setup, usage examples, and error handling guidance are provided in documentation.
